simulator.disclaimer: *Savings are calculated by comparing the selected EV against an equivalent combustion vehicle in the same category (Urban, SUV, Sedan etc.), using efficiency certified by Inmetro (PBEV 2026). Results may vary with driving style.
simulator.tcoDisclaimer: *Estimates based on market averages. Consult your insurer and dealer for real figures.

methodology.title: Calculation Methodology
methodology.subtitle: Data sources, assumptions and formulas behind the catalog, savings simulator, TCO and route planner.
methodology.sourcesIntro: All calculations start from public and official sources, with the reference date displayed on the site itself.
methodology.sourcesPbev: PBEV/INMETRO — range, energy consumption (MJ/km) and power per model. Reference {{ref}}.
methodology.sourcesPrices: Prices — Guia PBEV market research, history through {{through}}. {{disclaimer}}
methodology.sourcesAneel: Electricity — ANEEL homologated tariffs (B1 residential, TE + TUSD, no ICMS and no tariff flag), main utility per state. Reference {{date}}.
methodology.sourcesAnp: Fuel — average resale prices (SHPC) per state, ANP. Reference {{date}}.
methodology.sourcesIpva: IPVA — rates and exemptions per state according to each state's Sefaz. Reference {{date}}. Confirm current rules with your state's Sefaz.
methodology.energyIntro: The electric cost uses a weighted average rate between residential AC charging and public DC charging:
methodology.energyFormula: average rate = AC price × (1 − DC%) + DC price × DC%
methodology.energyNote: The DC% slider defines the fraction of charging done at public stations. The default per-category consumption (kWh/100 km) can be replaced with your measured real-world consumption.
methodology.fuelIntro: The combustion comparison uses the reference consumption per category (km/L, PBEV/INMETRO cycle of equivalent vehicles):
methodology.fuelEthanol: Ethanol: volumetric consumption is {{factor}}× higher than gasoline's, reducing the effective km/L.
methodology.fuelFormula: cost = (km ÷ km/L) × price per liter · electric cost = (km ÷ 100) × kWh/100 km × average rate
methodology.ipvaIntro: IPVA is calculated on the vehicle value in the selected state:
methodology.ipvaFormula: IPVA = value × state rate (EV uses the BEV rate; combustion uses the standard rate)
methodology.ipvaExemptionNote: In states with a value cap for exemption, vehicles above the limit pay the standard rate:
methodology.tcoTitle: TCO — total cost of ownership (4 years)
methodology.tcoIntro: The TCO compares the EV with an equivalent combustion vehicle year by year, always on the depreciated vehicle value:
methodology.tcoDeprEv: EV depreciation: {{value}}% per year (38% over 4 years, linear)
methodology.tcoDeprComb: Combustion depreciation: {{value}}% per year (28% over 4 years, linear)
methodology.tcoInsEv: EV insurance: {{value}}% of the depreciated value per year
methodology.tcoInsComb: Combustion insurance: {{value}}% of the depreciated value per year
methodology.tcoMaint: Maintenance: per-service cost by category, proportional to kilometers driven — service every {{evKm}} km for EVs and every {{combKm}} km for combustion.
methodology.tcoIpva: IPVA on the depreciated value of each year.
methodology.tcoEnergy: Energy/fuel constant over the 4 years, according to the informed monthly mileage.
methodology.tcoResidual: Net advantage subtracts the EV's extra depreciation loss from the operating savings: net advantage = operating savings − (combustion residual value − EV residual value).
methodology.routeIntro: The vehicle's base consumption is derived from PBEV data:
methodology.routeNote: The 0.93 factor represents the usable battery capacity (93% of the gross declared capacity). Per-leg range considers the battery fraction available at departure and arrival, and consumption is adjusted by a conditions multiplier (temperature, terrain and driving style).
methodology.limitsPbev: PBEV range is measured on a standardized cycle; real consumption varies with weather, speed, load and HVAC use.
methodology.limitsPrices: Prices and rates are indicative and vary by region, utility and dealership.
methodology.limitsTaxes: IPVA rates and exemptions change every year; confirm with your state's Sefaz.
methodology.limitsNotAdvice: Estimates do not constitute purchase or investment advice.
